The linear solver to run together with IPOPT.
In general rules, ma57 is better than ma27 that in turn is better than mumps, however only this last one is free for any use. The other two require an academic licence (free like in free beer).

For this reason in the package we provide we include only mumps. If speed is a concern, please see developer instructions on the website on how to obtain ma57and ma27 libraries and compile the solver with them.

If the mortality multiplier in the cc scenarios table is defined using a “natural” probability of presence definition, a link is needed to translate it to a mortality of already planted (or favoured) species. In other words, management favouring some specific species reduces the natural mortality due to competition in the initial stages.
Mortality multiplier = (ratio of prob. of presence)^mortMultipier_link

If this parameter and “usePixelData” are both true, the modifiers for time of passage will be adjusted on input-load with a coefficient from a normal distribution aving avg. 1 and s.d. equal to the one in the region for volume productivity.

If this parameter and “usePixelData” are both true, the modifiers for time of passage will be adjusted with a multiplier proportional to the volumes of the given f.t. in the pixel. The multiplier will have average of 1 and s.d. equal to the CV in the region for volume productivity.

as the spatial variance works modifying the multipliers, be sure that tpMultipliers are present for each ft, even with just 1, otherwise no variance is computed ! No longer needed..
